hints: Compare corresponding points on the solid and broken graphs. Decide which coordinate changes sign.
Identify the reflection in the $y$-axis: $y = f(-x)$.
walkthrough:
The transformed graph is a reflection of $y = f(x)$ across the $y$-axis:
$$y = f(-x)$$

hints: Compare the heights of corresponding points while keeping their horizontal coordinates fixed.
Identify the vertical stretch with scale factor 2: $y = 2f(x)$.
walkthrough:
The transformed graph is stretched vertically by a scale factor of $2$ parallel to the $y$-axis:
$$y = 2f(x)$$

hints: Compare one recognisable point on each graph to identify the horizontal and vertical shifts.
Identify the translation by vector $\begin{pmatrix}-4\\-3\end{pmatrix}$: $y = f(x + 4) - 3$.
walkthrough:
The transformed graph has been translated $4$ units to the left and $3$ units downwards (vector $\begin{pmatrix}-4\\-3\end{pmatrix}$):
$$y = f(x + 4) - 3$$
